text: {"sql": "SELECT kind, cause, severity, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, ROUND(AVG(outdoor_temp_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c, MAX(ts) AS latest_ts FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY kind, cause, severity ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC", "columns": ["kind", "cause", "severity", "incident_count", "total_downtime_min", "total_cars_lost", "avg_outdoor_temp_c", "latest_ts"], "purpose": "Aggregate F10 incidents by stop cause and severity to identify recurring stop causes, ranked by total downtime."}

data.sql: SELECT kind, cause, severity, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, ROUND(AVG(outdoor_temp_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c, MAX(ts) AS latest_ts FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY kind, cause, severity ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC
data.purpose: Aggregate F10 incidents by stop cause and severity to identify recurring stop causes, ranked by total downtime.
